title: KVS configuration
description: Options of the KVS instances of a process. Each instanceId must be unique within the list, which JSON Schema cannot enforce.

kvsInstances.description: Options of each instance. The instanceId values must be unique.

instanceId.description: Identifier of the instance. Mandatory, no built-in default. Set in code by the KvsParameters constructor.

snapshotId.description: Snapshot to load on open, 0 is the current KVS data. Built-in default is 0. Set in code by KvsParametersBuilder::Snapshot().

defaults.description: Whether the default values are required, optional or ignored. Built-in default is optional. Set in code by KvsParametersBuilder::Defaults().

kvsLoad.description: Whether the KVS data is required, optional or ignored. Built-in default is optional. Set in code by KvsParametersBuilder::KvsLoad().

workingDir.description: Directory where the KVS files are stored. Built-in default is ./data_folder/. Set in code by KvsParametersBuilder::WorkingDir().

maxStorageBytes.description: Maximum total size of the instance files in bytes. Built-in default is unlimited. Set in code by KvsParametersBuilder::MaxStorageBytes().

snapshotMaxCount.description: Maximum number of snapshots kept, 0 disables snapshots. Built-in default is 3. Set in code by KvsParametersBuilder::SnapshotMaxCount().
